parents.title: Create full cross-module contract and event compatibility test suite
parents.acceptance: All ten module schemas/permissions have runnable fixture tests; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed.
